framing: NDJSON over stdio, LF-delimited, one JSON object per line
prompt: Create a file named spike.txt with the text hi, then read it back.
regenerate: ZCODE_BIN=<zcode.cjs> ZCODE_PROVIDER_ID=bigmodel-spike ZCODE_MODEL_ID=GLM-5.3 node scripts/spike/zcode-app-server-transcript.mjs src/main/zcode/fixtures/spike-session-transcript.ndjson — requires a personal provider entry (api-key, anthropic-messages) in ~/.zcode/v2/provider_config.json; app-server's Provider Registry loads providers only from the builtin template catalog plus the personal file, not from ~/.zcode/cli/config.json

transcript.directionMarker: each line gains a `direction` field ('in' from server, 'out' from client) ahead of the raw frame
transcript.turnOutcome: turn.completed with resultType=success; spike.txt created and read back
